glitches.what: Two bottles magically appear standing up in the box, accompanied by a puff of smoke.
The leftmost bottle lying down begins to morph and sink into the side of the box.

random_motion.what: Camera pans slightly to the right, contrary to 'locked camera' brief.

retake_hint: The prompt needs to enforce a static scene. Two extra bottles appear at 1s. The camera also pans when it should be locked. Specify 'static scene, locked camera, no objects appear or disappear'.
